blocks.text: CAUAYAN CITY — Students marched through the streets of Cauayan City on Monday, Nov. 16, waving placards declaring “Isabela Youth Reject Pax Silica” before gathering at the city freedom park to condemn the initiative. The students, members of Isabela Against Pax Silica (ISAPAX), held signs reading “Shut Pax Silica Down” and “Kakalam ang Sikmura ng Taumbayan kung Magiging Tuta ng mga Dayuhan” (People’s stomachs will churn if the government becomes a foreign lapdog). They joined a nationwide uproar following the Association of Southeast Asian Nations Summit hosted by Manila, amid concerns that the Pax Silica initiative would be affirmed there. The […]...
